sections.title: Field skills, food & land, British regions
changes: Twenty new sections from the BunkerBot survival pack, 59 in all
Field Skills group: Fire & Warmth, Field Shelters, Field Water, Field First Aid, Map & Compass (UK), Signals & Radio
Prepping adds Bags: EDC to INCH and Family & Dependants
Food & land, UK law first: Smallholding Livestock, Hunting & Trapping, Fishing, Butchery & Game, Food Preservation; Solar & Off-Grid Power
British Regions: interactive maps and guides for Yorkshire, Cumbria & the Lakes, the Peak District, Wales and the Scottish Highlands
43 rendered 3D scenes, 24 step-through animations, 4 turntables and 3 before/after sliders; Morse trainer, season wheel and solar sizer

sections.title: Prepping
changes: New Prepping group: nine sections on preparing before an emergency, written for UK households first
Prepping: Start Here, with a readiness ladder, a 'where do you live?' picker, a printable household plan and five practice drills
First 24 Hours: step players for the first day of a power cut, flood, gas leak or CO alarm, water outage, evacuation and being stuck in snow, also added to Emergency mode
The Prepped Home, Urban & Flats, Campervan & Mobile, Rural & Homestead, Bunkers & Shelter Rooms, Stockpile & Rotation, What to Buy

3D models you can turn and tap: a campervan, a buried shelter, a house's shut-offs, a block of flats, a fallout refuge room, a rain butt with first flush, a wood stove and flue, a get-home bag and a 72-hour kit
Extended campervan guide: choosing a van, payload and licences, 12 V wiring, water system, security, living in it, spares and FLOWER checks, range
New calculators: stockpile, van autonomy, van payload, van range, floor load, shelter air, bag weight; shopping list by budget; stock rotation tracker
Reliability check of every prepping page against primary sources, with a sources box on each
Gear Checklist filters by where you live; Bunker Bot knows the prepping pages and offers starter questions
